decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the dedicated charge-LED connector, CHGLED circuit, resistor values, and D1/R6 population states; no additional change is required.
J_LED_CHG is a dedicated charge-LED connector and does not change the existing J_PWR_POWER or J_PWR_SIGNAL interboard interfaces.
The charge-LED circuit decision does not change the J_BAT NTC terminal or battery thermal-monitoring behavior.
The source adds an electrical charge-LED connector but specifies no placement, orientation, spacing, mounting-hole clearance, or battery-cable access change.
R6 is part of the charge-LED circuit and is unrelated to the retained zero-ohm I2C conditioning resistors or I2C pull-ups.
The source does not change the L1 footprint, KiCad library resolution, or project portability requirement.
The charge-status LED changes do not alter the AXP2101 protection thresholds or the DW01A protection components and functions.
Adding a connector and resistor circuit to the existing power board does not change the number or functional partitioning of project boards.
The source specifies no change to board dimensions, aspect ratio, mounting holes, installation orientation, or USB-C edge placement.
J_LED_CHG is a separate two-pin charge-LED connector and does not resolve or modify the J_BAT connector family, part number, functions, or unresolved pin order.
The charge-LED connector and resistor changes do not affect USB D+/D- routing, enumeration, flashing, or USB connector sourceability.
The power-board charge-LED circuit does not change the sensor board's role as a connector fanout for external sensors.
